GV-01.deadlineNote: November monthly window: 1–10 Nov 2026; closes at 23:59 IST
GV-01.evidence: NITI Aayog's current official Opportunities page confirms that applications are accepted from 00:00 on the 1st through 23:59 on the 10th of each month. Its standing instructions support the November window.
GV-01.caveat: The application portal timed out during this audit; the November window is derived from the official recurring rule, not a new dated vacancy notice. Apply 2–6 months before the desired internship; unpaid and subject to selection.
GV-01.sourceType: Official government programme and recurring-window instructions

GV-03.deadlineNote: Apply by 1 Dec 2026 for a January 2027 internship; December's 1 Nov cutoff has passed
GV-03.sourceDateText: Standing official scheme; current guidelines are labelled Revised March 2020
GV-03.evidence: CCI's full official internship form remains available. Its linked guidelines require applications by the 1st of the preceding month, so 1 Dec 2026 is the next usable cutoff for January 2027 after the December-intake cutoff passed.
GV-03.caveat: The deadline is calculated from CCI's published recurring rule, not a newly announced January vacancy. Institutional certification and recommendation plus an approximately 200-word SOP are mandatory; selection is not guaranteed.

GV-04.deadlineNote: Standing July–November application window for a January 2027 start
GV-04.evidence: RBI's official scheme-announcement PDF confirms that January-start research internships accept applications during July–November. This standing calendar supports applications through November 2026; the current scheme webpage returned RBI's automated-access challenge during the check.
GV-04.caveat: Current scheme-page content and the application workbook could not be freshly retrieved because of RBI's access challenge. The recurring application calendar is supported by RBI's official PDF; recheck department eligibility, stipend and email instructions on the current scheme page before applying.

GV-05.evidence: CAG's live official application form explicitly accepts applications from the 1st to the 20th of every month. The Headquarters scheme PDF and current official listing remain available; public finances/budget, finance/commerce and tax are selectable domains.
GV-05.caveat: Unpaid; bring a laptop and meet attendance and institutional-document requirements. Finance-domain allocation depends on CAG's needs; a submitted application does not guarantee an internship.

GV-06.evidence: CAG's current official listing continues to offer its IA&AD field-office scheme. The shared official application form is live, allows station preferences and states that the application window runs from the 1st to the 20th of each month.
GV-06.caveat: Unpaid and subject to office capacity and local work allocation. The field-office PDF CDN returned 403 during this audit; the stable official listing and functioning shared form support the recurring November intake.

RT-02.deadlineNote: Official Mumbai and Bengaluru applications remain open through 30 Nov 2026
RT-02.evidence: Morgan Stanley's full official Return to Work page explicitly marks Mumbai and Bengaluru applications open through 30 Nov 2026, with separate Workday Apply links and a January–May 2027 programme.
RT-02.caveat: The listed application is for Mumbai; Bengaluru uses the separate linked Workday requisition JR043712. A career break of two or more years is required; the Mumbai role also specifies five years of corporate experience.
